title: Multimodal Reference Subtraction, Drone Voiceprint and Three-Dimensional Sound Meter for Drone Localization
description: Python package and simulation environment for 3D acoustic localization of drones with a six-microphone spherical array (D = 160 mm): drone sound library (synthetic rotor-noise models and public datasets), multimodal reference subtraction, drone voiceprint classification, voiceprint-guided SRP-PHAT 3D sound meter, neural localizer and Kalman tracking. Includes the project report (Revision 2).
